Record Class OllamaRemoteModel

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
uno.anahata.asi.ollama.OllamaRemoteModel
Record Components:
name - the unique model repository name and tag (e.g. "qwen2.5-coder:7b", "llama3.3:latest")
modifiedAt - the timestamp when this model tag was last updated on the registry
size - the size in bytes of the model archive
public record OllamaRemoteModel(String name, Instant modifiedAt, long size) extends Record
Immutable record representing an available remote model listed in Ollama's online registry (https://ollama.com/api/tags).

anahata
